title: Module 4: Curvilinear Motion — n-t and Polar Coordinates
description: Choose between normal-tangential coordinates (path-known motion) and polar/cylindrical coordinates (origin-anchored motion); decompose velocity and acceleration in each, including the rotating-unit-vector cross terms.

learning_objectives.statement: Decide when n-t coordinates or polar coordinates simplify a curvilinear-motion problem
Decompose velocity and acceleration in n-t coordinates with tangential and normal components at = dv/dt and an = v²/ρ
Compute polar-coordinate acceleration including the cross terms ar = r̈ - rθ̇² and aθ = rθ̈ + 2ṙθ̇
Recognize centripetal direction and apply it correctly in equilibrium of forces

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
